file: 292 Fortnite Pirate Shop Access and Dev Hour Explained.mp4

lines.t: Fortnite hid one item that makes almost the whole Item Shop free. And Epic won't say how rare it is.

full.credit: Clips: SypherPK; tmnglv; NOOB NOOB FRUIT (YouTube)

lines.t: It's Pirate Shop Access. Any chest on Crossbones Isle can drop it.

full.credit: Clips: SypherPK; tmnglv; NOOB NOOB FRUIT (YouTube)

lines.t: Find it, and you get two 14 day windows, one now and one in 2027, to claim V-Bucks items for free.

full.credit: Clips: SypherPK; tmnglv; NOOB NOOB FRUIT (YouTube)

lines.t: Players are opening thousands of chests. One account with it was reportedly listed for 10,000 dollars.

full.credit: Clips: SypherPK; tmnglv; NOOB NOOB FRUIT (YouTube)

lines.t: So what's dev hour? A fan theory that Epic will boost the drop on November 19th, when GTA 6 comes out. Epic has not confirmed it.

full.credit: Clips: SypherPK; tmnglv; NOOB NOOB FRUIT (YouTube)

lines.t: What's real: Treasure Hours, with boosted chest rewards. And you have until December 15th to activate it.

full.credit: Clips: SypherPK; tmnglv; NOOB NOOB FRUIT (YouTube)
